channel.title: Place North West - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Place North West (placenorthwest.co.uk)

item.title: Succession plan triggered at Hurstwood Holdings - Place North West
item.description: Chief executive and majority shareholder Stephen Ashworth will hand over the day-to-day running of the business to his son Sam.

item.title: Govt reveals why Liverpool, Crewe didn’t make new towns cut - Place North West
item.description: Victorious bidders had to prove they could accommodate more than the minimum of 10,000 homes, while also demonstrating they were in an economic growth area and had the political backing to deliver the scheme.

item.title: Avison Young promotes 11 in Manchester - Place North West
item.description: Dom Picot, Ramone Johnson, and Edward Blight have all been made directors, while eight more staffers have been bumped up to associate director level.

item.title: Chorley picks contractor for town hall decarbonisation - Place North West
item.description: Contractor Krol Corlett has been appointed by the local authority to deliver a £1.6m programme of works and planned preventative maintenance at the historic civic building.

item.title: Liverpool to give nod to more Pumpfields homes - Place North West
item.description: Rosmara Developments’ plans for 158 homes off Vauxhall Road are part of a growing wave of residential schemes being progressed in the area.

item.title: Govt awards £9m planning dept boost - Place North West
item.description: A total of eight North West local authorities claimed £92,300 each from the Development Management Fund to help power through housing applications.

item.title: Wirral shakes up leadership structure - Place North West
item.description: Having seen five regeneration directors depart within a three-year period, the council will now combine that role with leading on neighbourhoods amid a redrawing of senior roles.

item.title: Practical completion for Granada Studios overhaul - Place North West
item.description: Aviva Investors has reached the finish line on one of the core assets within the Enterprise City cluster in Manchester’s St John’s area.

item.title: Homes England hits roadblock on 250 Lancaster homes - Place North West
item.description: After nearly seven years of back-and-forth between statutory consultees and planning officers, the government agency saw its plans to build residences on the former Lodge Quarry Works rejected on Monday.

item.title: Brookes Bell relocates Liverpool office - Place North West
item.description: The marine consultancy has signed a 10-year lease on 5,500 sq ft at Peel Waters No10 Princes Dock.
